data.name: CompatibleModsSync
data.description:
Using multiple mods that share some features can lead to some confusion.
This mod will help you keep those features synchronized between those mods, and now you can change any one of them with your mind at ease.

Features:
- Sync Axel's Mod Menu and Franky's Mod Menu (Synced features: God Mode, Infinite Stamina, No Hunger, No Dehydration, No Sleep, No Fall Damage, Infinite Ammo, Lock Time, Time Speed, Walk Speed, Run Speed, Swim Speed, Jump Multiplier).
- Sync Franky's Mod Menu and Builder Buddy Settings (Synced features: Instant Build, One Hit Cut Trees,  Creative Mode, Infinite Build Items, Infinite Fire, Invisibility, Lock Time, Time Speed).
- Sync Builder Buddy and Axel's Mod Menu Settings (Synced features:  Lock Time, Time Speed).
- Sync Illuminate and Axel's Mod Menu  Settings (Synced features:  Flash Light Intensity, Lighter Intensity).
- Sync True Survival and StackMod Settings (Synced features:Max Meat Amount, Max Fish Amount, Max Bacon Bite Amount, Max Steak Bite Amount, Max Brain Bite Amount, Max Health Mix Amount, Max Health Mix Plus Amount, Max Energy Mix Amount, Max Energy Mix Plus Amount ).
- Sync Less Useless Flashlight and Axel's Mod Menu  Settings (Synced features:  Flash Light Intensity).
- Sync Less Useless Flashlight and Illuminate Settings (Synced features:  Flash Light Intensity).
- Sync Planter Tweaks and True Survival Settings (Synced features:  Mushroom Produced Count, Plant Growth Time).
